Worst case this reveals region (10%) x web reader (30%) x afternoon-free routine (55%) = about 165k, which stays above 100k. NEVER kill police or foreign victims, because combining them with what is already revealed would drop the pool below 100k. Never kill in the morning. Morning-only free routines are 35%, which would drop the pool to about 105k. Check the press conferences: about 200k is expected if L has every ability.
